entries.title: Worker base image tag is absent
entries.root_cause: The Dockerfile references a worker base image tag that was never published. Point it at a published tag or publish the intended tag.

entries.title: Web base image tag is absent
entries.root_cause: The web Dockerfile references a different nonexistent base image tag. Correct or publish that web image tag.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Like e1, BuildKit cannot resolve an image tag, but this is a separate web image reference requiring its own correction.

entries.title: Registry denies base image access
entries.root_cause: The build does not authenticate to the private registry before fetching the relay base image. Configure registry login for the build job.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The metadata fetch resembles e1 and e2, but the registry responds with an authentication error for an existing private image.

entries.title: Build context exceeds available disk
entries.root_cause: The runner runs out of disk space while copying the build context into BuildKit. Reduce the context or provide more disk space.
